d:
A two-storey building collapsed in Jwala Nagar, Vivek Vihar, Delhi, killing two people and injuring four others. But our ground investigation by Khabargaon reveals shocking conditions inside a premises with 70–80 rental rooms, ₹3,000–₹4,000 monthly rent, shared washrooms and serious questions about building safety.
With a factory operating on the ground floor and tenants living above, who is responsible for their safety? Who allowed such conditions?
Watch this Delhi Ground Report to uncover the reality of unsafe rental housing and the questions surrounding building regulations.
